title: Hearty Steamed Filipino Pork Wrap
description: A garlicky and juicy Filipino dish featuring turmeric, wrapped in leaves and steamed to perfection, perfect for a lazy Sunday
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pork chunks, turmeric, garlic, black pepper, and salt-free seasoning blend, and mix well.
Lay a banana leaf flat on a work surface and brush with a little water.
Place about 1/4 cup of the pork mixture in the center of the leaf.
Drizzle with a little fish sauce and lime juice.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a tight packet, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Place the packets in a Korean brass bowl or a large steamer basket.
Steam the packets over boiling water for 30 minutes.
Serve the packets hot, with steamed rice or vegetables on the side.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
